lines.text: After the plague ended, the LORD told Moses and Eleazar to count the men twenty or older on the plains of Moab.
Dathan and Abiram of Reuben's tribe rebelled with Korah's followers, and the earth swallowed them.
Zelophehad of Manasseh's tribe had no sons, only daughters.
The LORD said the land would be divided by vote, with each share based on the number of names counted.
Of the men counted at Sinai, only Caleb and Aaron were left, because the LORD said they would die in the wilderness.
